This plot is very small, and for sorghum I do not like to spend too much cash unless I have seen it pay. I will use a little chemical fertilizer because I already buy some for my other land, and I will also put manure since this plot is mine and I want to keep it strong. I will plant my local seed, not improved seed, because that is what I know and what works for me when the rain is uncertain. I will keep it rainfed, weed it with family labor, and only call a little outside help if work becomes heavy.
